_comment: Hinglish -- Hindi in Roman script. THIS IS THE REFERENCE REGISTER: every string here is copied byte-for-byte out of the guided-setup UI as it was field-tested, and English/Devanagari are translations OF this file, not the other way round. Tokens the operator matches by eye against another screen -- 'Router Fleet', 'Download .rsc', 'Generate', 'Rotate the RouterOS API password', 'WinBox Terminal', '.rsc', 'cloudguest-api' -- are identical in all three bundles on purpose: the Master console generator they refer to is English-only, so translating its button names would send him hunting for a control that does not exist.
lang.label: Bhasha
shell.title: Guided Setup — {{router}}
shell.noPhases: Abhi koi setup phase load nahi hua.
shell.resetConfirm: Is router ka guided progress mit jayega (jo answers diye the woh sab). Router pe kuch nahi badlega. Reset karein?
shell.finishedBody: Saare phases ho gaye. Guest ab is router pe sign in karke internet chala sakte hain. Kuch baad me toota to seedha "{{recovery}}" phase kholo.
phase.rscDownloaded: Is phase ke commands ka .rsc download ho gaya
phase.reRunnable: har router pe same · dobara chala sakte ho
phase.copyProvesNothing: Copy ho gaya matlab router pe chal gaya nahi hota. Neeche wale checks hi asli saboot hain.
phase.gateOpen: Sab clear -- aage badh sakte ho
phase.somethingElse: Kuch aur ajeeb dikh raha hai?
phase.gateHint: Har check ka natija "{{pass}}" ya "{{warning}}" hona chahiye.
phase.secretsHint: Pehle "mere paas copy hai" tick karo.
check.fixHeading: Theek karne ke liye -- jo case match kare wahi karo:
check.afterFix: Fix ke baad upar wala step dobara chalao aur naya output paste karo.
check.noFix: Is check ke liye koi ready-made fix nahi hai -- diagnostics me dhoondo.
check.openDiagnostics: Inme se kuch match nahi hua -- diagnostics kholo
copy.failed: Copy nahi hua -- neeche se manually select karke copy karo.
copy.done: Copy ho gaya -- ab WinBox Terminal me paste karo
diag.title: Kya dikh raha hai?
diag.placeholder: Jo screen pe dikha, wahi likho -- jaise 'spinner atka' ya 'certificate warning'
diag.noMatch: Is filter me kuch nahi mila -- "{{all}}" pe click karke dobara dekho.
generated.heading: Pehle: Master console se yeh chunk paste karo
generated.body: Yeh hisse is router ke apne hain (IDs, keys, secrets) -- inhe yahan nahi dikhaya ja sakta. Master console kholo, script generate karo, aur neeche wale naam ke chunk copy karke router pe paste karo. Uske baad is page ke universal blocks chalao.
generated.secretsOnce: Yeh secrets sirf ek baar dikhte hain
generated.secretsBody: WireGuard key, RADIUS secret aur API password dobara nahi mil sakte. Master console me "Download .rsc" hi tumhari asli copy hai -- usse pehle tab band mat karna.
generated.step9Note: Step 9 ki safai ke baad aa rahe ho? Master console me "Rotate the RouterOS API password" wala box bhi tick karna -- warna "API Access" chunk script me aayega hi nahi aur router ka cloudguest-api user wapas nahi banega. Normal setup me is box ko haath mat lagana.
generated.ack: Mere paas copy hai -- .rsc download kar liya ya safe jagah save kar liya.
generated.nonSecretNote: Master console me "Download .rsc" dabakar poori script ki ek copy rakh lo -- usme aage ke phases ke secrets bhi hain, jo dobara nahi dikhenge.
regen.trigger: Master console me dobara "Generate" dabana pad raha hai? Pehle yeh padho.
regen.heading: Ruko -- dobara Generate router ko chup-chaap maar deta hai
regen.p1: Generate dabate hi server pe naya WireGuard key aur naya RADIUS secret ban jata hai. Router ke paas purana hi rehta hai, kyunki script "agar pehle se hai to haath mat lagao" style me likhi hai.
regen.p2: Natija: tunnel aur guest login dono band, aur router pe ek bhi error nahi dikhega. Saare chunks dobara paste karne se bhi theek nahi hoga. Pehle router se purane secrets hatane padenge.
regen.typeName: Aage badhne ke liye router ka naam type karo:
regen.namePlaceholder: Router ka naam bilkul waisa hi likho
regen.tail: Phase 9 pehle check karta hai ki secret mismatch hai bhi ya nahi, phir sirf secrets ka reset deta hai -- router ka baaki setup bacha rehta hai. Uske baad hi naya Generate karna, aur us Generate me "Rotate the RouterOS API password" wala box tick karna.
route.title: Guided Setup
route.demo: Guided Setup demo session me available nahi hai — yeh ek asli router ke against chalta hai. Platform operator account se sign in karo.
route.notFound: Router nahi mila, ya tumhare paas iska access nahi hai.
check.pasteLabel: Router ka output yahan paste karo
check.pastePlaceholder: Terminal se poora output copy karke yahan paste karo -- app khud padhkar bata degi.
check.redacted: {{count}} secret value hata di gayi ({{keys}}) -- app me sirf redacted text rehta hai.
check.columnSecret: Is table me secret wala column ho sakta hai jise app safely kaat nahi paayi. Isko kahin aur copy mat karo -- `print detail` chala ke uska output paste karo.
check.overrideUnknown: App verify nahi kar paayi -- maine khud dekh liya, theek hai
check.unverifiable: Is step ko app verify nahi kar sakti. Iska koi router output nahi hota jise padha ja sake -- ye sirf aapke dekhne pe hai. Jo neeche tick karoge wo aapka apna confirmation hai, app ka nahi.
check.fixHeadingMatched: Output dekh kar yahi case match hua -- yeh karo:
